description: Stamp sequential Bates numbers (PREFIX-000001) on every page corner — the legal document numbering standard.

faqs.a: Bates numbering is the legal-industry standard for uniquely numbering pages across documents: a fixed prefix plus a zero-padded sequence.
Yes — the stamp is drawn onto each page's corner in the exported PDF, permanently.
Choose the starting number and the digit width (e.g. 6 digits → 000001).
faqs.q: Can I start at a number other than 1?

howto: Set the prefix, starting number and digit width.
Pick which corner gets the stamp.
Click "Stamp" and download the numbered PDF.
title: PDF Bates Stamper
